landing.meta_tagline: Car and smartphone installments in one experience
landing.meta_description: Apply for car or smartphone installments in one place and track your request with your mobile number. Submitting an application is not a financing approval.
landing.hero_subtitle: Choose the service, enter your details once, and follow your request step by step, whether it is for a car or a smartphone.
landing.services_title: Your car and your phone.. one simple request
landing.disclaimer_short: Submitting an application is not a financing approval; all applications are reviewed and verified.
landing.disclaimer_full: Submitting an application through the platform does not constitute a financing approval. All applications are reviewed and verified, and the final approval and its terms are set once the review is complete.
landing.car_desc: Tell us the car type, model and value, then complete your details to submit your application.
landing.phone_desc: Apply for your new smartphone in a few short, clear steps, from the same place.
landing.step_1_desc: Car or smartphone; for a car, add its type, model and value.
landing.step_2_desc: Personal details, monthly salary and obligations, employer and employment duration.
landing.step_3_desc: The team reviews your application and contacts you; track its status with your mobile number anytime.
landing.req_title: Have these ready before you start
landing.req_work: Employer type and current employment duration
landing.req_car: For cars: type, model and value
landing.cta_subtitle: Apply for car or smartphone installments now, or track an application you already submitted.
landing.form_section_subtitle: Three short steps, then track your request anytime with your mobile number.
landing.net_income_note: For guidance only; it is not a financing decision.
landing.success_hint: Keep your request number to track its status anytime.
landing.error_generic: Something went wrong while submitting. Please try again shortly.
landing.error_rate_limited: Too many attempts. Please wait a minute and try again.
landing.track_subtitle: Enter the mobile number used in the application to see its latest status.
landing.footer_tagline: A digital platform to submit and track car and smartphone installment applications.
